comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Item: Hermes' Sandals
Description: A pair of winged sandals, it is said to have been worn by Hermes, a god in Greek mythology.
Equip type: Foot
Stats: +1 Sail Handling, 500 fame to equip.

It was only available in GAMA from the Ancient Glory Mystery Bottle (released 2/25/2016).

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Ancient_Glory_Mystery_Bottle

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: Hey Guilder, this WAS available from Red Grab bag which was in the Viking Event early on Maris. This is the same bag that dropped the swords of the various winds. I received two and traded one to my comp mate for... The pilgrim boots you linked. XD

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Cool. Statement amended: this item is available in Maris, though as it came from a limited time event it's likely to be somewhat rare and difficult to come by.

Fortunately, an alternative +1 Sail Handling foot equip (with additional stats) which can often (and randomly) be obtained from Historical Events can be found here:

Pilgrim of the Ages Boots

Good hunting to you whichever one you may want. Cheers.
